purpose: Teach: 乳児/遺骨/銃弾/勾留/留置/採血/病的/課さ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、乳児の発達心理学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you covered research on infant developmental psychology in your paper, didn't you.
lines.style: Warm teacher's greeting on the name. Clear, unhurried pace with a gently rising confirmation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦死者の遺骨収集の歴史研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, and I covered historical research on collecting the remains of soldiers killed in the war.
lines.style: Quick teen yes, then concentrating hard. Slightly rushed middle, a proud little lift at the finish.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 銃弾の弾道学の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you covered research on bullet ballistics in your paper, didn't you.
lines.style: Even, thoughtful delivery. Small pause before the technical term, approval warming the tag ending.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、勾留期間の刑事訴訟法研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered criminal procedure research on pretrial detention periods.
lines.style: Careful over the legal words, like walking on ice. Steady pace, quiet exhale of relief after.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 留置施設の処遇研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You dealt with research on how detainees are treated in police holding facilities, didn't you.
lines.style: Soft reflective tone, unhurried. The question lands gently, more invitation than test.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、採血、つまり血液採取の医学的標準研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered research on medical standards for blood sampling — drawing blood, that is.
lines.style: Confident on the clarifying phrase she rehearsed. Bright, diligent pace with a hint of showing off.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 病的肥満の医学社会学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You addressed medical-sociology research on morbid obesity as well, didn't you.
lines.style: Voice lowered slightly for the heavier topic. Slow respectful pace, warmth held underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、法律で課された規制の経済影響研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered research on the economic impact of regulations imposed by law.
lines.style: Final answer with settled teenage certainty. Even pace, a small satisfied landing on the last word.
